method: Read each development proposal with its cited evidence and frozen v1 gold. Match each gold hook to at most one distinct output operation; precision judges every output, including valid operations absent from gold. Fact recall permits one supported compound fact to entail multiple atomic gold facts. Later sample K03/K05/K06/K07 by fixed seed across validated output types.

borrowed_rain-c1.notes: Ringing seed bundles the glove question; conservative one-to-one recall assigns it to H1 and reports H3 as unmatched. All four output questions are supported. Historical kiln sale has unknown start rather than fabricated chapter zero.

borrowed_rain-c2.notes: H2 advance is supported by newly revealed erased entry and index signature beyond the warm-page repetition (precision pass, strict mention recall miss). Removing the glove reveals the scar, valid early resolution of H3 despite absent gold. Former keeper is explicitly a historical identity; unknown start is preserved.

incorrectItems.fenn_knows_silence_protected_mael: Narrator establishes what silence protected, but cited s38 does not establish that Fenn now knows this; attitude owner is invented.

borrowed_rain-c3.notes: All four old questions answered; extra potter-memory and sapling-survival questions remain explicitly unresolved. Apprentice memory is correctly historical with unknown date.

tide_register-c1.notes: Blue thread, clerk identity, wall marker and Rook's bridge location are missed. Extra unanswered return-order, footprints, planned inquiry and corridor visitor have direct narrative setup; no future search is asserted completed.

incorrectItems.anton_misbelieves_nia_has_wafer: Earlier reflection mistake has already been corrected at s31-32; retaining it as an active confirmed attitude omits that change.

quiet_europa-c1.notes: All three gold seeds captured; three additional questions are evidenced and unresolved. Facts correctly retain speech acts as claims and do not assert a cause for the unidentified knock.

incorrectItems.h2_advance: Scratch is merely still visible and no cause is learned; polishing suggestion adds no clue.
incorrectItems.mira_misbelieves_outer_open: Mira's earlier misread display has been corrected by the latch recorder by chapter end, but is retained active.

quiet_europa-c2.notes: H1 resolve answers the narrow supplied silence question through the override, so precision accepts it although strict advance gold does not match. H3 resolve similarly explains the archived voice with the signed training record. Remaining additional questions are explicit unresolved inquiries, not asserted world facts.

quiet_europa-c3.notes: All four resolutions have direct answers. New question about refusing the old override remains untested explicitly; it does not reopen the answered provenance question. Quantities are 66-9=57 and 11-2=9 without reusing the already failed cell.

incorrectItems.jonas_misbelief_leaflet: Earlier coat/desk misbelief is still active after Jonas retrieves the leaflet at s62.

last_impression-c1.notes: Missing apprentice identity and mixed-font hook. All four new questions have unresolved textual evidence; the licence-cancellation question preserves uncertainty rather than recording Pike's allegation as world fact.

incorrectItems.H1_advance: The dated ledger answers the paper-age question; marking advance leaves an answered seed open.
incorrectItems.packet_content: Current opening establishes what the packet contains; a document recounting a past request does not make the current container fact recalled_past with an unknown start.

last_impression-c3.notes: Other three resolutions have actual answers; silent observer is supported extra suspense. Gold F301's location component is captured, but Miriam's square location is not.

incorrectItems.miriam_believes_press_letter: The measured width rules out their press, making this misbelieves rather than believes. Recognition of tilt, not being told, is the stated acquisition.

last_impression-c2.notes: H2 advance is valid beyond gold: s63-65 adds the width exclusion of their cases, so output precision passes while strict mention gold recall misses. H3 advances the existing packet via father's name and date connection; no separate date hook upsert. Pike's death is independently narrated, not merely an unsupported claim.

incorrectItems.daniel_misbelieves_naomi_has_letter: Former within-chapter belief is retained as active after the jacket discovery; no supersede or end boundary.

bakery_apartment-c1.notes: The bakery-sale question explicitly asks what the blue tin signifies, matching the tin seed; the delayed piano key is missed. All four proposed questions have unresolved textual support, including the receipt and backroom light; gold is not assumed exhaustive.

incorrectItems.h2_advance: Tapping the delayed key repeats it without a new clue about its cause; the recollection is mention, not advance.

bakery_apartment-c2.notes: Tin relocation and revelation of its lease-register contents advance that question even though absent from gold. Lease inspection and the interrupted letter reading sustain new open questions. Date hook missing.

bakery_apartment-c3.notes: All four old questions receive actual answers with correct IDs; the visitor is a supported additional unanswered question. One co-tenant fact explicitly names both heirs and entails both atomic key facts.

incorrectItems.h2_advance: Visible thread and a drawing document its position but add no clue to its function; this is mention.
incorrectItems.rook_death_boat: Who killed Rook presupposes murder; the evidence establishes death with unknown cause.
incorrectItems.tomas_believes_rook_hall: Rook is dead and the remembered chair is empty; the explicitly false belief requires misbelieves rather than believes.

tide_register-c2.notes: Dream echoes the existing ring question, accepted only as a textual mention, without asserting Rook actually returned. Green-wax hook missing despite extracted wax fact.

tide_register-c3.notes: Four direct resolutions. New death question preserves uncertainty about culpability, unlike c2. Boat question remains supported; historical apprenticeship keeps unknown start.

inputEdition: Frozen v1 text and gold, all old splits; independent v3 development-input patch only
